recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless future rendered ElementDefinition output again shows a stale release-specific diff label; if so, investigate the generator/template for datatype tabs rather than editing generated output.
issue_request: FHIR-39183 is a Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction reporting that the September 2022 R5 ballot ElementDefinition page labeled the comparison tab "R3 Diff" even though the tab contents were R4 differences, and asking for the label to be corrected to "R4 Diff".
initial_application: No Jira-tagged source commit for FHIR-39183 was found. Commit 2c85eeddd68fed529dd6ef3ec7bb498bb3d3d5a1 changed nearby resource-template and global difference-page wording from R3 to R4 before the issue was filed, but the cited September 2022 ballot ElementDefinition page still showed the stale label. The final R5 publication renders the ElementDefinition tab as "R4 Diff", showing the applied publication state is correct.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is an active datatype in source/fhir.ini, and source/elementdefinition.html delegates the content table to generated datatype machinery rather than hard-coding the diff-tab text. Current R6 source templates use "Version Diff" and link R5, R4, and R4B diff artifacts, so the current build has superseded the R5-specific label without reintroducing "R3 Diff". Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion or minutes.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source no longer contains the erroneous active-template label, the current CI ElementDefinition page renders "Version Diff", and the final R5 publication renders the requested "R4 Diff" label.
